bugs.evidence: Browser check incident-status-update failed twice: after selecting the first incident status select, it remained OPEN instead of INVESTIGATING after 5 seconds. Failure screenshot: /root/.emergent/automation_output/20260831_192710_266/incident-status-update-failure.png. Backend cross-check passed in test_tscheck_incidents.py (POST /api/detection/analyze 200, GET /api/incidents 200, PATCH /api/incidents/{id} 200 with returned status INVESTIGATING), so the remaining issue is in the frontend incident-row update flow or its handling of the selected existing row. No browser console errors were recorded.

action_items: Investigate the frontend incident status mutation for the first rendered incident: capture PATCH response and verify query invalidation/state update; rerun incident-status-update after fixing.
